name: Bewitching!
source: Mabel is the new girl at Hawthorne Academy; a prestigious magical institution for gifted witches. Will she manage to find her place in her new school and, perhaps, find love before the big dance?
translation: 梅布尔是霍桑学院的新生，这所著名魔法学府专门招收天赋出众的女巫。她能否在新学校找到自己的位置，并在盛大舞会到来前，寻得一段爱情？
